labelingExamples.NOTE: ID format: uppercase letter = comment (A, B, C…), lowercase letter = product within that comment (a, b, c…). Aa = comment A product a, Ab = comment A product b. Copy the EXACT bracket IDs from the input.

products.NOTE: q0: 'Picture quality is amazing' — feature only, no use case context. q1: 'Just set it up' — generic, omitted.

promptConfig.specialInstructions: Projector type alone (DLP, 3LCD, laser) is NOT a product — only extract when attached to a brand/model. Brightness specs: extract as { "name": "brightness", "value": "3000 lumens" } when the commenter directly attributes brightness to the product being reviewed. Feature disambiguation: 'gaming' covers VRR, game mode, 4K@120Hz gaming, and overall gaming responsiveness. 'input lag' covers measured or perceived delay numbers. 'fan noise' covers acoustic noise during operation. 'brightness' covers lumen output and ambient light handling. Do not confuse gaming issues with input lag numbers. Projector model names vary widely: Epson uses EH-TW prefixes, BenQ uses HT/TK/W series, XGIMI uses product names (Horizon, Halo, Elfin), JVC uses DLA-N series, Optoma uses UHD/HD prefixes. When a comment compares a projector to a TV, keep only the clause that evaluates the projector. 'keystone & alignment' covers keystone correction, lens shift, and setup flexibility — do not split these into separate features.
